The '''f-2 Light Ion Cannon''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] made by [[CoMar Combat Systems/Legends|CoMar Combat Systems]]. It cost 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], weighed half a [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]],<ref name="GG6-2" /> and had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] range of three-point-six [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="PP" />
